title: Recover P by STNFS on a directly sampled region: 121.400000

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns P with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied Q with success at least 0.39 under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5, and all classical work is bounded by 2^121.400000 dense-Fp12 units (ledger: proof.md section 8). Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit: code hashes, quadrature parameters and integration controls, and the upward-rounded ledger and success from refinement.json. Does not rerun the full recurrence.
Optional full recomputation of pool, region, yield, ledger, filtering, retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 10 s natively).
